title: Decide whether one "Accept every pick" press counts as your word on each item
why: The waiting page offers one press that accepts every recommended pick; sessions need to know whether that press approves each item, including steps that cannot be undone.
note: Deferred (shiv, Oct 26): your answer is needed; ask nothing for now. From c71 (PR #636): rule 2a says your save on a page only you can write counts as your word; not ruled: whether "Accept every pick" is your word on every item it accepts. Advisor pick, unruled: yes for items that can be undone, and a separate press for any item that cannot. Until ruled, sessions treat a bulk accept as your word only on reversible items.
